patterns.note: Content is structured in full-width sections, alternating between white, light grey, and dark teal backgrounds, with content typically constrained to a central maximum width.
Headings use a prominent, bold sans-serif typeface for strong visual hierarchy and impact, while body text uses a highly legible, slightly lighter sans-serif.

A high-contrast palette is used, featuring a vibrant yellow as a primary accent and CTA color, dark teal for deeper section backgrounds and footer, and clean white and light grey for main content areas.
The top yellow header bar, containing the logo and main navigation, becomes sticky and remains fixed at the top of the viewport after the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Complex concepts and frameworks are explained using integrated, hand-drawn, whiteboard-style illustrations that visually break down information within content sections.

technique_notes: The primary navigation system is implemented as a sticky header, where the top bar transitions from its initial position to a fixed state at the top of the screen once the user scrolls beyond the hero, ensuring persistent access to navigation links.

Visual explanations are provided through custom, hand-drawn illustrations that are embedded directly into content blocks, serving as diagrams to clarify processes or concepts rather than purely decorative elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, creating a clear and impactful visual hierarchy, with hero text being particularly oversized.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for buttons, input fields, and content blocks, contributing to a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: A balanced spacing character is maintained throughout the site, with generous vertical padding between sections and a clear grid-based layout for features and testimonials.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its seamless integration of clean, modern web layouts with unique, hand-drawn, whiteboard-style illustrations. This blend creates an approachable yet authoritative educational feel, making complex ideas visually engaging and easy to digest.
